entries.name: Aerathiel
entries.revision: Fable proposal — 2026-10-04 batch rebalance (roster pass) / Dust classification / forked tree
entries.above_nuke_rationale: Fable proposal following the director precedent of RUL-2026-10-04-001 (Blood-Enchanted Eyes, Reaper's Embrace 50 → 52) and RUL-2026-10-04-002 (Shakunetsu Sakura, Sakura-ame 50 → 52): Total Disintegration's +2 Damage is the controlled payoff of Particle Collapse's self amplify setup on Atomic Shield and lifts Particle Cannon 50 → 52, past the 50 Nuke tier; Death's March and Decaying Touch go 40 → 42 and stay Normal. It is the tree's only Damage node, so no legal allocation adds more than +2 and nothing reaches 55. The pre-batch tree's burst route was +5 Damage (Particle Cannon 50 → 55) on this damage-led kit; the controlled payoff keeps the burst identity at a fraction of that tier impact. Pending director review.

entries.name: Primal Radiance
entries.revision: Fable proposal — 2026-10-04 batch rebalance (roster pass) / Fire classification / forked tree
entries.above_nuke_rationale: Apex Conflagration's +2 Damage lifts Fire Style: Beast 50 → 52 (Fire Style: Squirrel 40 → 42), past the 50 Nuke tier, as the payoff of a deliberate burst route (Hunter's Brand exposure → Fang and Ember self buff → Apex Conflagration). Precedent: RUL-2026-10-04-002, Shakunetsu Sakura, with the same 40/50 Damage tier pair (Scorch: Sakuragari 40 → 42, Sakura-ame 50 → 52 under Conflagration in Bloom's +2), and RUL-2026-10-04-001 (Blood-Enchanted Eyes, Reaper's Embrace 50 → 52). The reach differs: Fire is a far more widely shared element than Scorch (29 other bloodlines against Scorch's one), so Apex's +2 also lifts any off-kit 50 EP Fire row the owner casts to 52 (count unverified). Only builds holding Apex Conflagration exceed 50, by at most +2. Fable proposal; flagged for director review.
